children: Senegal's euro-denominated bonds edged up on Wednesday, partly recovering from record lows hit a day earlier after the country reached a staff-level agreement with the International Monetary Fund for a $2.2 billion three-year loan package.
A euro-denominated bond maturing in 2037 rose 1.3 cents to be bid at 48.46 cents on the euro. Dollar-denominated securities were little changed.
